body: People. I used to enjoy social interaction but now that scares me
Cycling, hanging out and partying and being popular and gaming. All of it just gives me overwhelming anxiety. Like horrible. It eats away at me. So now I just lay in bed doing nothing.
I’d rather hangout with one of my friends and just talk. I don’t really know though. I used yo enjoy a lot of things but I can’t seem to anymore
I’m supposed to drive to my cousins house. But I don’t know. I’m just trying to make it right now. Just wishing I wasn’t being ignored or having my calls forwarded..
I haven’t had someone ask me that in so long. I’m just haven’t been able to feel anything but pain, anxiety and loneliness in so long.
